description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to load generator scenarios for distributed testing, including specific implementations for ping and fan-out scenarios.

classes.name: ILoadGeneratorScenario<TState>
classes.description: Interface for load generator scenarios with methods to get scenario name, retrieve state for a worker, and issue requests.

classes.name: PingScenario
classes.description: Implementation of a load scenario that performs a ping operation.

classes.name: FanOutScenario
classes.description: Implementation of a load scenario that performs a fan-out ping operation.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Property returning the name of the scenario.

methods.name: GetStateForWorker
methods.description: Method to get the state object for a specific worker.

methods.name: IssueRequest
methods.description: Method to issue the load request.

methods.name: GetGrain
methods.description: External method to retrieve a grain reference.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: External method to perform a ping operation on a grain.
